item.title: Search Or Filter Devices
item.description: 1. Device search link Under “Device” of the APP, you can search for devices by device serial number 2. Device filtering link Two conditions for filtering link Filter by device type Filter by device online status

item.title: Device Details
item.description: Entrance link Click on the device in the device list interface to enter the device overview page Function Overview linkThe menu at the top right of the device details page contains three operations: Parameter setting, Device alias, Unbind device (see below for details). Remote upgrade link Moved to “My → OTA Assistant”: the device details menu of the new version of the App no longer provides a remote upgrade entry.

item.title: Device Statistics
item.description: Click a device in the device list to enter the device details Click to enter Statistics from the menu below (before the version update, this tab was named “History”) Statistics support four views: day, month, year, and all In the chart, you can view the data at a certain point in time by continuously pressing

item.title: Device Event
item.description: Click a device in the device list to enter the device details Click to enter the event from the menu below Events have two states: Occurring and Recovered. You can filter by clicking the title above Click on an event to view detailed information about the event
